title: An Unexpected Connection
content:
After leaving the office, Sneha wandered aimlessly through the streets.

Her mind was restless.

The conversation with Yagnesh kept replaying inside her head.

Unable to bear the noise in her thoughts, she walked into a quiet café near her locality.

She ordered a cup of coffee and chose a seat near the television mounted on the wall.

For several minutes, she simply stared at the steaming cup in front of her.

Then suddenly...

Something on the television caught her attention.

A news channel was broadcasting an international business segment.

On the screen appeared a familiar face.

Siddu.

The anchor spoke enthusiastically.

"Indian-born entrepreneur Siddhartha has once again made headlines in France after leading his company to another remarkable achievement. At just thirty-two years old, he has become one of the country's most respected business leaders."

Sneha froze.

Her eyes remained fixed on the screen.

Five years had changed him.

He looked more mature.

More confident.

Yet the smile she knew so well was still the same.

Without realizing it, a small smile appeared on her face.

Just then...

A conversation from the table behind her caught her attention.

A woman was speaking on the phone.

"Yes, sir."

"As instructed, the appointment with Mr. Siddhartha has been confirmed."

Sneha's heartbeat instantly quickened.

The woman continued,

"It's scheduled for two weeks from now."

After listening for a few seconds, she sighed.

"But sir..."

"I can't travel to France right now."

There was another pause.

Then she spoke again.

"Alright."

"If it's necessary, I'll go."

A few moments later, she ended the call.

Sneha stared at her coffee.

Her heart raced.

Was she really going to meet Siddu?

For several seconds, she tried to control herself.

She failed.

Finally, she stood up and walked toward the woman's table.

"Excuse me..."

The woman looked up.

"Yes?"

Sneha hesitated.

Then she asked,

"Are you going to meet Siddhartha?"

The woman immediately looked surprised.

"Who are you?"

"And why do you seem so excited?"

Sneha laughed awkwardly.

"It's a very long story."

"But I need a favour."

The woman folded her arms.

"What kind of favour?"

Sneha took a deep breath.

"I just..."

"I want to know how he's doing."

"And..."

"I want to see him."

The woman studied her carefully.

For a moment, neither of them spoke.

Then a knowing smile appeared on the woman's face.

"Are you in love with him?"

The question caught Sneha completely off guard.

She opened her mouth to answer.

But no words came out.

Her silence was enough.

The woman chuckled softly.

"I understand."

A faint blush appeared on Sneha's cheeks.

The woman smiled.

"Alright."

"When I reach France and meet him..."

"I'll call you."

Sneha's eyes brightened instantly.

"Really?"

The woman nodded.

"Yes."

Without wasting another second, Sneha quickly shared her phone number.

"Thank you."

"Thank you so much."

The woman simply smiled.

A few moments later, she stood up and picked up her handbag.

As she began walking toward the exit, Sneha suddenly realized something.

"Wait..."

The woman turned around.

"I forgot to ask."

"What's your name?"

For a brief moment, the woman remained silent.

Then she smiled.

"My name is Shreya."

Sneha's eyes widened slightly.

The woman smiled gently and continued,

"I know Siddu..."

"We go a long way back."

Without another word, she turned and walked out of the café.

Leaving Sneha standing silently in the café...

She had no idea that the woman she had just met was far more than a stranger.

She was someone who had once changed Siddu's life...

And now...

Fate had chosen her to change it once again.
